mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, duration_days AS "durationDays", description FROM study_plan WHERE status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY sort_order, id
SELECT id, code, name, duration_days AS "durationDays", description FROM study_plan WHERE id = #{planId} AND status = 'ENABLED'
SELECT id, day_number AS "dayNumber", title, description FROM study_plan_day WHERE study_plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY day_number

SELECT i.id, i.target_type AS "targetType", i.target_id AS "targetId", CASE WHEN i.target_type = 'TOPIC' THEN t.name WHEN i.target_type = 'QUESTION' THEN q.title ELSE NULL END AS "targetTitle", i.sort_order AS "sortOrder" FROM study_plan_item i LEFT JOIN topic t ON i.target_type = 'TOPIC' AND t.id = i.target_id LEFT JOIN question q ON i.target_type = 'QUESTION' AND q.id = i.target_id WHERE i.study_plan_day_id = #{dayId} ORDER BY i.sort_order, i.id
SELECT id FROM profile WHERE is_default = TRUE
SELECT id FROM profile WHERE is_default = TRUE FOR UPDATE

SELECT sp.id AS "planId", sp.code AS "planCode", sp.name AS "planName", sp.duration_days AS "durationDays", pp.started_at AS "startedAt" FROM profile_plan pp JOIN study_plan sp ON sp.id = pp.study_plan_id WHERE pp.profile_id = #{profileId} AND pp.active = TRUE
mapper.update: UPDATE profile_plan SET active = FALSE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE profile_id = #{profileId} AND active = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO profile_plan (profile_id, study_plan_id, started_at, selected_at, active) VALUES (#{profileId}, #{planId}, #{startedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, TRUE) ON CONFLICT (profile_id, study_plan_id) DO UPDATE SET started_at = EXCLUDED.started_at, selected_at = EXCLUDED.selected_at, active = TRUE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: INSERT INTO study_plan (code, name, duration_days, description, sort_order, status) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{durationDays}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}, 'ENABLED') ON CONFLICT (code) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, duration_days = EXCLUDED.duration_days, description = EXCLUDED.description, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP RETURNING id

INSERT INTO study_plan_day (study_plan_id, day_number, title, description) VALUES (#{planId}, #{dayNumber}, #{title}, #{description}) ON CONFLICT (study_plan_id, day_number) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP RETURNING id
SELECT id FROM topic WHERE code = #{code} AND status = 'ENABLED'
SELECT id FROM question WHERE external_key = #{externalKey} AND status = 'ENABLED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_plan_item (study_plan_day_id, target_type, target_id, sort_order) VALUES (#{dayId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{sortOrder}) ON CONFLICT (study_plan_day_id, target_type, target_id) DO UPDATE SET sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order
